title: Defragmentation: drain the cheapest nodes so a waiting 4-node gang can start
purpose: Recreate S06's spread state, so the 4-node gang waits. Plan which nodes to empty with the fewest GPUs moved, drain them (the evicted small pods are recreated on other nodes), and let the gang take the whole nodes. Count the work the moved pods lost since their last checkpoint.

checks.description: the plan empties 4 nodes and the moved GPUs fit on the other nodes
checks.because: Nodes are sorted by GPUs in use; only nodes whose GPUs are all held by movable pods are candidates.

checks.description: after the drain every small job runs again elsewhere, and the 4-node gang runs on the emptied nodes
checks.because: The podFailurePolicy ignores DisruptionTarget, so the Job recreates each evicted pod.

checks.description: compaction cost work: the moved pods lost the time since their last checkpoint
checks.because: Each pod checkpoints every 600 s (ds17/checkpoint-seconds); everything since is lost.
